implementation: OSNEXUS Crypto Library - AES XTS functions
description: OSNEXUS Crypto Library (OSNCL) is used by the core services within the Linux based QuantaStor Software-Defined Storage Platform. OSNCL links with a FIPS enabled version of OpenSSL library and it provides functionality to handle all key generation and encryption services used by QuantaStor platform.
